prompt: インソール歩行データからサルコペニアリスクを予測する新しい実験環境を作成してください。3-phase構成、LightGBM、ゲート条件 Phase A: Spearman ρ ≥ 0.5、Phase B: Spearman ρ ≥ 0.3。

assertions.text: CLAUDE.md contains all 10 prime directives including Anti-Sycophancy, Pre-Registration, Full Reporting
feature_availability.yaml exists with inference_available and inference_unavailable sections
Exactly 3 phase scripts exist (run_phase_a.py, run_phase_b.py, run_phase_c.py)
Test files exist for each src module (tests/test_*.py count >= src module count)
Hydra config.yaml contains gates section with phase_a and phase_b thresholds
00_HYPOTHESES.md contains pre-registration and exploratory vs confirmatory sections
02_METRICS.md contains Spearman rho >= 0.5 and >= 0.3 gate thresholds
Gate conditions mention Spearman correlation specifically
